content: {"paper_id":"W2129053638","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"bayesian-inference","exact_quote":"We describe a dynamic Bayesian network that infers probability distributions over attended objects and spatial locations directly from observed data.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确使用动态贝叶斯网络从观测数据推断注视对象与空间位置的概率分布，属于概率模型下的推断过程。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","reason_zh":"摘要提到gist、bottom-up saliency、physical actions、events等多模态信息，但未明确它们是同一对象的互补视图并显式利用视图间关系，证据不足以确认多视图学习设定。"}],"input_issues":[]}
